title: VALUES of a one-side column includes the blank row for orphans
query: EVALUATE VALUES ( Product[Color] ) ORDER BY Product[Color]

source.quote: VALUES includes the blank row caused by an invalid relationship, if present
If a relationship is invalid, the VertiPaq engine automatically adds a row containing BLANK in every column of the table on the one-side of the relationship
source.supports: Sales has ProductKey 9, which Product lacks, so Product gets the blank row

derivation: Product[Color] holds Red, Blue, Red: two distinct values. Sales rows 3 and 4 have ProductKey 9, not in Product, so the relationship is invalid and Product gets a blank row; VALUES returns it. Sorted ascending, BLANK comes first.
notes: Not marked ordered: where BLANK sorts is a separate case (assumption:blank-sorts-first).
